lesson: Raw pace extrapolation of difficulty is noisier than 'no change' for first ~600 blocks of an epoch; shrinkage required

Epoch log-adjustments under constant hashrate are MA(1) in Poisson noise, autocorr -0.5. Observed 2023+ r=-.27 is this mechanism, not miner behaviour. Naive-forecast error sd from Poisson alone is 3.15%, not 2.2%.

Binary run/curtail decisions are insensitive to difficulty-forecast accuracy (flips only at ~zero margin). Forecast value is linear-exposure value (hedging/forward sales), ~$2-4k per EH/s per epoch at k=500 vs naive, ~0.8pp vs standard estimator.
Epoch-adjustment target caps n at ~109 test points; power floor R2~0.2+. Weak-signal hypotheses must move to a daily hashrate-proxy target (n~2000) or block-level targets.
Header timestamps lag true arrival by median 18.5s (template time); arrival data removes this but does not change memorylessness conclusions.

Continuous covariates found nothing in the residual; the only structure was a scheduled event. Event-conditioning is the representational gap, but with 3-4 events it cannot be validated at protocol standard.

web_fetch reaches mempool.space and api.blockchain.info (mempool charts only; mining charts 404) when the sandbox cannot. Data must be transcribed; integrity-check via an independent overlapping column (price).

Forecast value is bounded by the variance share of the target: difficulty is 8-26% of 14d revenue variance. A program optimising difficulty forecasts cannot exceed ~$32k/EH/epoch VOI even with perfect information; price hedging, not prediction, addresses the dominant component.
